'''Sahib''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operative who infiltrated the [[Royal Court]] of [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="To Free the Forgotten" /> posing as the [[Rajah]]. Along with his fellow Rebels, he tricked [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Lariss]] into exiling the disguised Rebels to the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Captivity]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Grehollo system/Legends|Grehollo system]]</ref> There, they liberated a group of political prisoners, including [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Farazzish]] and [[Templeton]], with the assistance of exiled [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] war hero, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dedelin]]. Climbing to the top of the nearby mountain, [[Borolol's Claw]], they were rescued by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], flying aboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]].''<ref name="To Free the Forgotten" />
